title: Vanishing of higher bounded Hochschild cohomology
summary: We prove that every bounded Hochschild cocycle of degree at least two on a complex von Neumann algebra, with values in the algebra itself, has a bounded primitive. Together with the established degree-one inner-derivation theorem, this resolves the Kadison–Ringrose cohomology conjecture positively.

review.reason: Proves vanishing of higher bounded Hochschild cohomology for von Neumann algebras, addressing Kadison–Ringrose.
